apply-hash.doc: hash-verified application of the cheatsheet onto the target artifact; bespoke integrity gate

apply-handback.doc: owner handback record; conductor-owned, no unit persona

hash-bound-smoke.doc: smoke attestation hash-bound to scaffold content; bespoke integrity gate

authorized-full-run.doc: human-gated detached resource run; not an agent gate

hash-bound-eval.doc: eval run hash-bound to checkpoint + eval-spec; bespoke integrity gate

lab-publish.doc: owner atomic report-bundle publication after manifest verification; explicit project/experiment/version

spec-atomic-transaction.doc: owner atomic PRD transaction with version snapshot; conductor-owned

lab-setup-handoff.doc: owner records the successor tracked workflow for a finished run — a registered follow-up route/attempt or an explicit human gate; a prose 'evaluate later' note is not completion

ship-deploy.doc: human-authorized deployment record; conductor-owned and never self-authorized

inline-next.doc: the same checked payload runs the successor before returning

supervised.doc: a registered continuation supervisor observes child termination and starts the successor exactly once

human-gate.doc: an explicit human gate declared in human_gates blocks the successor

monitor.doc: a checked monitor waits on an external state change and reports a typed condition match
